boards.school_name: The University of Texas at Dallas
boards.title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
boards.description: Ten named public destinations on corridors around UT Dallas, each with one documented reason to stop.

cards.title: UT Dallas Station — Silver Line access
cards.subtitle: Waterview Parkway corridor, north of campus
cards.notes: Use the station’s north-campus location as a clear starting point for a rail trip or a photographed transit stop.
cards.short_summary: A named rail station immediately north of UT Dallas.
cards.evidence_claim: DART locates UT Dallas Station north of Synergy Park Boulevard and south of Waterview Parkway, on the north side of campus.
cards.access_notes: Transit fares and service conditions may apply; consult DART before travel.

cards.title: Northside at UT Dallas — campus-edge landmark
cards.subtitle: Synergy Park Boulevard corridor, beside north campus
cards.notes: Orient yourself at this named campus-edge destination before continuing along Synergy Park Boulevard toward the station.
cards.short_summary: A named destination directly beside UT Dallas’s north edge.
cards.evidence_claim: UT Dallas’s current parking map labels “Northside at UT Dallas” beside Synergy Park Boulevard and the UT Dallas DART Station.
cards.access_notes: This is a private mixed-use/residential destination; use public-access areas only.

cards.title: Canyon Creek Park — courts and playground
cards.subtitle: Aspenwood Drive corridor, southwest of campus
cards.notes: Bring a ball, racquet, or picnic item and use the listed park amenities rather than treating the stop as a pass-through.
cards.short_summary: A city park with active recreation amenities.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of Richardson lists Canyon Creek Park with picnic and playground equipment, a shelter, pool, baseball field, and tennis courts.
cards.access_notes: The adjacent pool has separate admission requirements; park amenity availability can vary.

cards.title: Campbell Ridge Park — a walkway stop
cards.subtitle: West Campbell Road corridor, west of campus
cards.notes: Use the park’s documented walkways for a short outdoor pause while following the Campbell Road corridor.
cards.short_summary: A small city park with walkways on West Campbell Road.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of Richardson lists Campbell Ridge Park at West Campbell Road and Custer Parkway and identifies walkways as an amenity.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor access is subject to posted city park rules.

cards.title: CityLine Park — boardwalk and trail link
cards.subtitle: Routh Creek Parkway corridor, east of campus
cards.notes: Walk the elevated boardwalk, then connect to the Central Trail from this named CityLine green space.
cards.short_summary: A CityLine green space connected to the Central Trail.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of Richardson says CityLine Park includes an elevated boardwalk and connects with the CityLine DART station and Central Trail.
cards.access_notes: Use the public park and trail areas; observe posted rules.

cards.entity_name: Charles W. Eisemann Center for Performing Arts
cards.title: Eisemann Center — public gallery foyer
cards.subtitle: Performance Drive corridor, Galatyn Park Urban Center
cards.notes: Visit during the stated public hours to see the Grand Foyer and Green Mezzanine Gallery, then check the event calendar.
cards.short_summary: A City of Richardson arts venue with public interior spaces.
cards.evidence_claim: The Eisemann Center states that its Grand Foyer, ticket office, and Green Mezzanine Gallery are open to the public Monday through Saturday.
cards.access_notes: The listed public spaces are open Monday–Saturday, 10 a.m.–6 p.m.; performance tickets are separate.

cards.title: Community Fountain — plaza landmark
cards.subtitle: Performance Drive corridor, Galatyn Park Urban Center
cards.notes: Make the public-plaza fountain your visual waypoint when arriving at the Eisemann Center and Galatyn Park Station area.
cards.short_summary: A named fountain in the Eisemann Center’s public plaza.
cards.evidence_claim: The Eisemann Center identifies the Texas Instruments Foundation Community Fountain in its attractive public plaza.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor plaza access is subject to site conditions and scheduled events.

cards.title: Galatyn Park Station — arts-district rail link
cards.subtitle: Performance Drive corridor, Galatyn Park Urban Center
cards.notes: Pair a rail arrival with the short walk to the Eisemann Center, which identifies the station just a few hundred feet away.
cards.short_summary: A named rail station serving Galatyn Park Urban Center.
cards.evidence_claim: The Eisemann Center states that DART Rail’s Galatyn Park Station is a few hundred feet from its front doors.
cards.access_notes: Transit fares and service conditions may apply; consult DART before travel.

cards.title: Sherrill Park Golf Course — municipal fairways
cards.subtitle: Lookout Drive corridor, east of campus
cards.notes: Use this named municipal course as a documented landmark along Lookout Drive; reserve play directly with the facility if needed.
cards.short_summary: A City of Richardson golf-course destination on Lookout Drive.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of Richardson’s parks guide lists Sherrill Park Golf Course at 2001 East Lookout Drive.
cards.source_title: City of Richardson Parks & Recreation Guide
cards.access_notes: Golf play, reservations, and facility access may require payment or advance arrangements.

cards.title: Cottonwood Park — Belt Line park stop
cards.subtitle: West Belt Line Road corridor, southeast of campus
cards.notes: Use the named city park as a daylight outdoor stop along Belt Line Road and confirm any activity-specific rules before visiting.
cards.short_summary: A named Richardson municipal park on West Belt Line Road.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of Richardson lists Cottonwood Park at 1301 West Belt Line Road in its municipal park locations.
cards.access_notes: Use public park areas in accordance with posted city rules.
